title: Three Quiet Evenings
description: Make room for stillness through small, intentional changes to your evening.

days.title: Make space
days.description: Create a quiet moment away from the screen.

steps.title: Arrive as you are
steps.text: You do not need to finish everything before taking a moment to rest.

steps.title: Make a little room
steps.text: Choose somewhere nearby to put your phone while you take a short break.

steps.title: A quiet prayer
steps.text: Lord, help me welcome this moment of rest with gratitude.

days.title: Reconnect
days.description: Make room for ordinary human connection.

steps.title: Look beyond the screen
steps.text: Consider one person whose company you appreciate.

steps.title: Make a small connection
steps.text: Choose a time to call, message or spend a few minutes with that person.

steps.title: Notice what matters
steps.text: What kind of connection would you like to make more room for?

steps.title: Small beginnings
steps.text: A useful daily rhythm can begin with one ordinary decision.

steps.title: Choose your next step
steps.text: Choose one small evening practice that you would like to continue.

steps.title: Carry this into tomorrow
steps.text: Lord, give me patience and wisdom in the small choices ahead.
